sunGbkSupplement.comparison_method: Same Unicode only. Crop exterior all-blank rows/columns. No scaling, rotation, stroke edits or codepoint substitution. Exact compares all cropped pixels and dimensions. Near comparison minimizes symmetric-difference ink pixels over integer translations dx,dy in [-2,+2], without clipping; this is tolerance for placement only. Dice=2 intersection/(A ink+B ink); Jaccard=intersection/union. Counts include exact matches.

limits: The 202 historical records are not 202 independent native font designs: 193 normally mapped complete available sources and 9 provenance/outline-limited sources.
The historical index covers 162 normal and 9 limited current catalog records. The other 68 current records are outside that index, though some were separately checked by name.
Current fixed PNGs and 23 available withdrawn-source sample checks are sample-only, not whole-font deduplication.
No conclusion of originality, manual design history or exhaustive coverage of every current/removed font follows from these comparisons.
